scenario_title: S3 lifecycle rule expired old base images
title: Missing resources on cloud-api
impact: Operations on older resources failed on cloud-api
symptom: [ANOMALY] cloud-api 2026-08-14 18:43-22:03: cloud-api: 251 of 331 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-08-14 18:43 and 2026-08-14 22:03 UTC (peak error ratio 0.95 vs baseline median 0.0). 3 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 1.929 s vs baseline band up to 0.453 s.
error_templates: Unexpected exception while calling image-svc: HTTPError: 404 Not Found

_templates.macro: Terraform change shortened the images/ expiration {old} -> {new} days; S3 deleted older base images and servers booting from them failed.
_templates.remediation: Restore expiration = {old} days; restore the images from the replica bucket / versioning.

rca.macro: Terraform change shortened the images/ expiration 365 -> 30 days; S3 deleted older base images and servers booting from them failed.
rca.remediation: Restore expiration = 365 days; restore the images from the replica bucket / versioning.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `Unknown base file: /var/lib/nova/instances/_base/<HEX>`.
